lines.en: label osakospring6:
scene osakosarabar1
That’s okay, though. Because we decide to head over to Sara’s place so I can drink away the pain — a method I’m sure Sara herself would endorse if she weren’t too busy taking inventory at the moment.
lines.zh: 不过,没关系。因为我们决定转去 Sara 的店,好让我借酒消愁——我确信这个方法 Sara 本人也会背书,如果她此刻不是忙着盘点库存的话。

lines.en: It feels a little weird being alone here with Osako when I found out along the way that the rest of our normal group is hanging out at our normal bar tonight.
lines.zh: 一路上我得知,我们那群老伙计今晚正聚在我们常去的酒吧——于是和 Osako 两个人单独来这儿,感觉有点怪。

lines.en: I guess it’s harder for her to try and be herself when there’s a magnet inside of her too though. She’d just drift back to Wakana if given the opportunity.
lines.zh: 不过我猜,当她的体内也装着一块磁铁时,想做回自己就更难了。只要有机会,她就会飘回 Wakana 身边。

lines.en: And I imagine Wakana knows this as well since she seems to support this little outing if what my new partner in witchcraft is saying is true.
lines.zh: 而我想 Wakana 也明白这一点——如果我这位新巫术同好说的话可信,她似乎还挺支持这次小出游。

lines.en: But hey, it’s not like we need to be with them in the first place. We can make our own decisions. And it’s way easier to talk without Rika getting riled up about trivia or Imani trying to fuck me in the bathroom.
lines.zh: 但话说回来,我们又不必非要和他们待在一起。我们可以自己做决定。而且,没有 Rika 为琐事炸毛、没有 Imani 想把我拖进洗手间里上,谈话要容易得多。

lines.en: The only question is what will we talk about now that our moment for exploration has come and gone?
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是,探索的时刻已然来过又走了,我们还能聊什么?

lines.en: Do we sit here and pretend that it was a success? That she’s closer to comfortable with herself now?
lines.zh: 我们要坐在这里假装那是场成功吗?假装她现在离自在地做自己更近了一步?

lines.en: Or do we treat it like it is — one more failure in a list that I’m sure will be full of them before she can find what makes her happy.
lines.zh: 还是实事求是地看待它——失败清单上又添一笔;我确信,在她找到能让自己幸福的东西之前,这份清单还会写满。

lines.en: : So, that was a total failure.
lines.zh: : 所以说,那彻底失败了。

lines.en: Okay. Good. At least she isn’t indecisive enough to not decide for me.
lines.zh: 好。很好。至少她还没优柔寡断到连替我下结论都下不了。

lines.en: : For what it’s worth, you never struck me as a witchcraft person anyway. Just the type who fucks them.
lines.zh: : 顺带一提,反正你从来就不像玩巫术的人。倒像那种把巫术师上了的类型。

lines.en: scene osakosarabar2
: At least I know where to go girlfriend hunting if Wakana ever does break up with me.
lines.zh: : 至少,万一 Wakana 真跟我分手,我知道该去哪儿猎女朋友了。

lines.en: : She would have done that already if you two weren’t meant to be together.
lines.zh: : 要是你们俩不是天造地设,她早就分了。

lines.en: scene osakosarabar3
: Oh, shut it. Nobody is meant to be with anyone. The two of us can fail just as easy as anybody else. Probably easier now that you and I are off on our own while they get drunk and talk about us.
lines.zh: : 哦,闭嘴吧。谁跟谁都不是天生一对。我们俩和别人一样容易失败。说不定还更容易——毕竟你我现在独自行动,而他们正喝着酒议论我们。

lines.en: : What do you think they’re saying?
lines.zh: : 你觉得他们在说什么?

lines.en: : I don’t know. Hasn’t really crossed my mind.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。还真没往那儿想过。

lines.en: : You expect me to believe that a girl who is chronically worried about her place in this world just hasn’t put any thought into what her significant other is saying about her behind her back?
lines.zh: : 你指望我相信,一个长期焦虑自己在这世上位置的女孩,从没想过她的另一半在背后怎么议论她?

lines.en: scene osakosarabar4
: Maybe I’ve just been having so much fun with you that it’s distracting me from all the worrying?
lines.zh: : 也许我只是和你玩得太开心,开心到把那些焦虑都岔开了?

lines.en: : You’re dying inside, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你内心正在枯死,对吧?

lines.en: scene osakosarabar5
: Hah! It probably seems that way if I’ve resorted to taking night classes, huh?
lines.zh: : 哈!我都沦落到上夜校了,看起来多半是那样,对吧?

lines.en: scene osakosarabar6
: And, you know...maybe it’s true to a certain extent. I mean...it’s obviously true to a certain extent.
lines.zh: : 而且,你知道……也许某种程度上是真的。我是说……显然,某种程度上是真的。

lines.en: : But for the first time in my life, it isn’t really about Wakana. Or love. Or...security or stability or any of that other stuff I’ve been getting buried by since college. It’s about me. And that’s...great.
lines.zh: : 但有生以来第一次,这真正无关 Wakana。无关爱。无关……安全感、安稳,或者大学以来埋葬着我的其他一切。它关乎我。而这……很棒。

lines.en: : I kind of like this feeling. Failure. Trying things out and then looking back on them and thinking it was funny I ever expected it to work in the first place. That’s not a thing I’ve ever felt before.
lines.zh: : 我有点喜欢这种感觉。失败。尝试某样东西,然后回头审视,发现自己当初居然盼着它能成,真好笑。这种感觉我从未有过。

lines.en: scene osakosarabar7
: It’s like what I was saying to your little sister earlier. I had plenty of friends when I was younger. I did really well in all of my clubs.
lines.zh: : 就像我之前对你妹妹说的那样。我小时候朋友多得很。我在所有社团里都干得很出色。

lines.en: : And, while my family is nowhere near as wealthy as Wakana’s, they’ve always been supportive of me. So if I ever did fail at anything, which I can’t really remember, I’m sure they would have helped me through it.
lines.zh: : 而且,虽然我家远没有 Wakana 家那么有钱,但他们一直支持我。所以就算我真的搞砸过什么——我其实记不得有——我相信他们也会帮我挺过去。

lines.en: : Sorry, are you just bragging now?
lines.zh: : 抱歉,你这是在炫耀吗?

lines.en: scene osakosarabar8
: Maybe a little. Why? Does that strike a nerve as someone who fails at everything all the time?
lines.zh: : 也许有一点。怎么,作为一个事事失败的人,这戳到痛处了?

lines.en: scene osakosarabar9
: You know I’m just kidding, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我在开玩笑,对吧?

lines.en: : Yeah...I know. I just wish I was able to handle it as well as you do.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我知道。我只是希望自己也能像你一样应付得来。

lines.en: : Maybe once you get used to failing at everything, though, you’ll start feeling a little differently about it.
lines.zh: : 不过,等你习惯了事事失败,说不定感受就会变得不太一样。

lines.en: : Akira.
lines.zh: : Akira。

lines.en: : You’re not a failure.
lines.zh: : 你不是失败者。

lines.en: : You’re really not.
lines.zh: : 你真的不是。

lines.en: : Osako-
lines.zh: : Osako——

lines.en: scene osakosarabar10
: I talked to Imani the other day.
lines.zh: : 前几天,我和 Imani 谈了谈。

lines.en: : Okay. But being good at sex isn’t enough to make me not a-
lines.zh: : 好。但性技好,不足以让我不是一——

lines.en: : Not about that, idiot. Though, it definitely did come up and I definitely do know way too much about your penis now.
lines.zh: : 不是那件事,白痴。虽然那确实聊到了,而且我现在对你的 penis 了解得确实太多了。

lines.en: : It was only a matter of time...
lines.zh: : 那只是时间问题……

lines.en: : I’m talking about that thing you two talked about.
lines.zh: : 我说的是你们俩谈过的那件事。

lines.en: scene osakosarabar11
: You do know that...walking away from something because it’s what’s best for you doesn’t make you a failure, right?
lines.zh: : 你该知道……因为那是对你最好的选择而离开某样东西,并不会让你成为失败者,对吧?

lines.en: : It does when it’s your responsibility. You’d think the same thing about yourself if you had to leave the dojo.
lines.zh: : 当那是你的责任时,就会。要是你必须离开道场,你也会这么看自己。

lines.en: : If I had to choose between my own personal happiness and the dojo, I’d choose myself every time. I’m not going to suffer just because it’s “the right thing to do.” And you shouldn’t either.
lines.zh: : 如果要我在我自己的幸福和道场之间做选择,我每次都会选我自己。我不会仅因为那「是正确的事」就去受苦。你也不该。

lines.en: : I’m assuming Wakana doesn’t know yet?
lines.zh: : 我猜 Wakana 还不知道?

lines.en: : What makes you think that?
lines.zh: : 你怎么会这么想?

lines.en: : The fact that she hasn’t come for my head.
lines.zh: : 她还没来取我首级这个事实。

lines.en: scene osakosarabar12
: Pfft.
: Yeah, okay. Fair.
lines.zh: : 是啊,好。有理。

lines.en: scene osakosarabar13
: Do you really think she’d get mad at you over something like that, though? If she knew it was something you needed to do to feel human again?
lines.zh: : 不过,你真觉得她会为那种事生你的气吗?如果她知道,那是你重新找回做人感觉的必需?

lines.en: : The word “again” implies that I have ever felt human at all.
lines.zh: : 「重新」这个词,暗示了我曾经有过做人的感觉。

lines.en: : Haven’t you?
lines.zh: : 你没有过吗?

lines.en: : Those practice fights with Ayane...those nights at the dive bar, kicking all of our asses at trivia with Rika...
lines.zh: : 和 Ayane 的练习对打……破酒馆里的那些夜晚,和 Rika 一起在问答游戏里把我们全员杀得片甲不留……

lines.en: scene osakosarabar14
: That time we went down on our partners together?! Surely you must have felt human in those moments, right?
lines.zh: : 还有那次我们一起给各自的伴侣口交?!那些时刻里你肯定感觉自己是个人,对吧?

lines.en: scene osakosarabar15
: Do you need another drink? I’ll buy the next one.
lines.zh: : 你要再来一杯吗?下一杯我请。

lines.en: : This is kind of hard for me.
lines.zh: : 这种事对我来说,有点难。

lines.en: : Akira, I know you're attracted to me. But it just isn’t going to happen.
lines.zh: : Akira,我知道你被我吸引。但这事就是不会发生。

lines.en: : Not that. This...bonding thing. Having to open up to someone without envisioning what choices and words will lead to sex the quickest.
lines.zh: : 不是那个。是这种……交心的东西。必须向一个人敞开自己,却不能同时盘算什么样的选择和言语能最快通向性爱。

lines.en: : You don’t have to open up. We can just drink.
lines.zh: : 你不必敞开。我们光喝酒也行。

lines.en: : I kind of want to, though. I just don’t know how.
lines.zh: : 不过,我有点想。只是不知道怎么做。

lines.en: : Then...is that really how you look at everyone? Is every conversation just a means of getting a girl’s pants off?
lines.zh: : 那么……你看每个人的眼光,真的是那样吗?每一段对话,都只是扒下女孩裤子的手段?

lines.en: : Maybe not all of them...but enough for it to be unhealthy.
lines.zh: : 也许不是每一段……但足以称之为不健康。

lines.en: : Especially when you remember who I’m talking to.
lines.zh: : 尤其是当你想起我正在对谁说这些。

lines.en: : Any amount is unhealthy when you take that into consideration. So walking away from school wouldn’t just be what’s best for me, it’d be what’s best for everyone.
lines.zh: : 把这一点考虑进去,任何分量都不健康。所以离开学校,不只对我最好,对所有人都最好。

lines.en: : Despite all that, though...I still can’t bring myself to do it.
lines.zh: : 尽管如此……我仍然下不了手。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : Akira...
lines.zh: : Akira……

lines.en: scene osakosarabar16
: Are you sure you want to admit this to me? Because I’m not saying you’re about to admit anything...but I do know what you’re implying. And I want to stop you before you say something you’ll regret.
lines.zh: : 你确定要向我承认这个吗?我不是说你要承认什么……但我知道你在暗示什么。而我想在你说出会后悔的话之前拦住你。

lines.en: : I don’t know, Osako.
lines.zh: : 我不知道,Osako。

lines.en: : I have no idea.
lines.zh: : 我毫无头绪。

lines.en: scene osakosarabar17
: Hah...
: I can’t even pretend to understand what you’re going through right now. And that sucks. It really does.
lines.zh: : 我连假装理解你现在的处境都做不到。这很糟。真的很糟。

lines.en: : Like...I want to help, but...what can someone even do to help with a problem like that?
lines.zh: : 就是说……我想帮忙,可是……面对那样的问题,一个人到底能做什么来帮?

lines.en: : At least you see it as a problem. That’s more than most are able to offer up.
lines.zh: : 至少你把它视作问题。这就已经比大多数人能给出的都多了。

lines.en: : Sure. But, like you said a second ago, most of the people you’re dealing with aren’t...smart enough yet to make their own decisions.
lines.zh: : 当然。不过,就像你刚才说的,你要面对的大多数人,还没……聪明到能自己做决定。

lines.en: : No one our age knows. Wakana doesn’t know. Imani doesn’t know. Rika doesn’t know. So now I have to be the one who knows. And I don’t know what to do about it.
lines.zh: : 没有我们这个年纪的人知道。Wakana 不知道。Imani 不知道。Rika 不知道。所以现在,我必须是那个知道的人。而我不知道该怎么办。

lines.en: : I’m sorry I’ve burdened you with the knowledge of who I really am, Osako.
lines.zh: : 抱歉让你背上了「知道我究竟是什么样的人」这个负担,Osako。

lines.en: : You should be...
lines.zh: : 你是应该……

lines.en: scene osakosarabar18
: Why’d you have to go and make me care about you?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么非要跑去让我在乎你?……

lines.en: : Life was so much easier when you were just some asshole-ish creepy guy flirting with the rich girl at my karate class. I wasn’t ever supposed to care.
lines.zh: : 当你还只是在我空手道课上,和那个有钱女孩调情的、混蛋味的怪人时,一切容易得多。我本来永远不该在乎的。

lines.en: : So why do you?...
lines.zh: : 那你为什么在乎?……

lines.en: : What was it about the way I act...how I constantly annoy you and flirt with you despite you hating it and...how I unintentionally make your girlfriend ignore you for my sake that made you like me? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 我的行为里到底是什么……让我不断烦你、不断调情哪怕你讨厌、还让我无意间让你女朋友为了我而无视你——到底是什么让你喜欢上了我?我不明白。

lines.en: : And you think I do?
lines.zh: : 你以为我就明白?

lines.en: : Until recently, I was fine with you just being a step or two above an acquaintance. But...
lines.zh: : 直到不久前,我都觉得你只是比熟人多高一两级的存在,挺好。但是……

lines.en: : You seem different when it’s just us. Better. Real.
lines.zh: : 只有我们俩的时候,你看起来不一样。更好。真实。

lines.en: scene osakosarabar19
: The flirting and shit doesn’t bother me. I fuck with you too. It’s just...frustrating doing all this stuff to try and “find myself” beside someone who’s decided it’s okay to just stay lost.
lines.zh: : 调情什么的并不困扰我。我也耍着你玩。只是……在某个已经决定「迷失着也挺好」的人旁边,拼命做这一切来试图「找回自己」,实在令人沮丧。

lines.en: : It makes me feel like you’re only helping at all because it gives you one more excuse to not do the same yourself. And that pisses me off...
lines.zh: : 这让我觉得,你之所以愿意帮忙,只是因为那又给了你一个自己不这么做的借口。而这让我火大……

lines.en: : I pity you, Akira. I pity the type of mind that can see what needs to be done to enact the changes you need and just...not even make an attempt to do the same.
lines.zh: : 我同情你,Akira。我同情那种头脑——明明看得见要做出你需要的改变该做什么,却……连试都不试一下。

lines.en: : Getting a new hobby won’t stop me from preying on teenagers, Osako.
lines.zh: : 换个新爱好,阻止不了我继续捕食少女,Osako。

lines.en: scene osakosarabar20
: And there it is...
lines.zh: : 而它来了……

lines.en: : I’m both proud of you and hate you for admitting that at the same time.
lines.zh: : 你把它说了出来,这让我同时为你骄傲,又恨你。

lines.en: : Because you have to deal with it now too?
lines.zh: : 因为现在你也不得不面对它了?

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Do I side with my morals and do what’s right? Do I ruin a friend’s life and, by extension, ruin a bunch of other lives in the process? It’s not exactly an easy choice.
lines.zh: : 我是站在道德一边、去做正确的事吗?去毁掉一个朋友的人生,并顺带毁掉过程中的一串其他人的人生?这可不是个容易的选择。

lines.en: : You wouldn’t be ruining anything — just making a handful of people very upset for a sizable amount of time.
lines.zh: : 你不会毁掉什么——只是会让一小撮人难过大段时间而已。

lines.en: scene osakosarabar21
: But then a girl would lose her father a second time. My partner would lose her best friend. My other friend would lose the man she’s rapidly falling for.
lines.zh: : 但那样的话,一个女孩就会第二次失去她的父亲。我的伴侣会失去她最好的朋友。我另一个朋友会失去她正迅速爱上的男人。

lines.en: scene osakosarabar22
: But, worst of all, I’d lose my witchcraft buddy!
lines.zh: : 但最糟的是,我会失去我的巫术搭子!

lines.en: scene osakosarabar23
: I’m surprised you can still make jokes after hearing what I just confessed to.
lines.zh: : 听完我刚才坦白的事,你还能开玩笑,我挺惊讶的。

lines.en: : I had a thousand red flags to soften the blow. I’d just hoped it would never be something that became so real.
lines.zh: : 我早收到过一千面红旗来缓冲这一击。我只是希望,它永远不会变成如此真实的东西。

lines.en: : But if you figured it out so easily, what’s stopping Wakana and Imani from doing the same?
lines.zh: : 可你既然这么容易就看穿了,又有什么能拦住 Wakana 和 Imani 看穿呢?

lines.en: : Easy. They like you more, so they’re giving you every benefit of every doubt that has ever existed.
lines.zh: : 简单。她们更喜欢你,所以她们把古往今来一切疑点的好处,全都给了你。

lines.en: : And how do you think they’d feel if they found out?
lines.zh: : 而你觉得,如果她们发现真相,会是什么感受?

lines.en: : Crushed. Both of them. Then they’d probably feel like failures too for looking straight past all of the signs you posted around them pointing directly to this.
lines.zh: : 崩溃。她们两个都会。然后,她们多半也会觉得自己是失败者——因为她们对竖在自己周围、直直指向这里的所有路标,视而不见。

lines.en: : I really am just fucking up everything then, huh?
lines.zh: : 所以说,我真的是在搞砸一切,是吧?

lines.en: : You sure are. Way to ruin the night, asshole.
lines.zh: : 你确实是。把夜晚毁掉的本事真不错,混蛋。

lines.en: : I bet you feel better about yourself now though, right?
lines.zh: : 不过,你现在自我感觉好一点了吧?

lines.en: scene osakosarabar24
: Yeah. I feel really great buying drinks for a predator. You got me there.
lines.zh: : 是啊。给一个捕食者买酒,让我感觉真是棒极了。这一点你赢了我。

lines.en: : Anyway...I think I am going to quit.
lines.zh: : 总之……我想,我要辞职了。

lines.en: scene osakosarabar25
: Everything just...makes more sense that way. And yeah, it’d make more sense if I stopped seeking the girls out entirely, but...
lines.zh: : 一切都……那样更说得通。而且没错,如果我连那些女孩都不再去找,会更说得通,但是……

lines.en: : They’re important to you...and that’s okay. It’s everything else you’re doing that’s not.
lines.zh: : 她们对你很重要……而那可以。不可以的,是你在做的其余一切。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Thank you for not using your karate to chop me in half.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你没有用空手道把我劈成两半。

lines.en: scene osakosarabar26
: Don’t mention it. Feel any better after getting that off your chest? Do you want to choose the next night class?
lines.zh: : 不足挂齿。把胸口那块卸下来之后,感觉好些了吗?下一门夜校课,想不想由你来挑?

lines.en: : No. I just want to not hate myself for a minute. That would be enough.
lines.zh: : 不想。我只想有一分钟不那么恨我自己。那样就足够了。

lines.en: : Guess we’ll just have to keep looking then. Maybe we’ll find something we can both enjoy?
lines.zh: : 看来我们只好继续找了。说不定能找到我们俩都能享受的东西?

lines.en: : Well, I’ve always wanted to try banging Wakana-
lines.zh: : 嗯,我一直想试试上 Wakana——

lines.en: : Actually, maybe I will chop you in half? It’ll cut down some of the calories I gained from drinking tonight and the world will be a safer place. The pros really do outweigh the cons here.
lines.zh: : 其实,也许我真该把你劈成两半?这能消耗掉我今晚喝酒摄入的部分卡路里,世界也会更安全。利真的大于弊。

lines.en: : I have never agreed with anyone so much.
lines.zh: : 我从未如此赞成过任何人。

lines.en: : Um...uh...Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 那个……呃……Sensei?……

lines.en: scene osakosarabar27
: Oh. Hey, Sana. I didn’t realize you were working tonight.
lines.zh: : 哦。嘿,Sana。我没想到你今晚上班。

lines.en: : Yuki is...not here again and...actually, that doesn’t matter right now...
lines.zh: : Yuki 又……不在,而且……其实,那件事现在不重要……

lines.en: : Can we talk?...
lines.zh: : 我们能谈谈吗?……

lines.en: : About what?
lines.zh: : 谈什么?

lines.en: : Just...something you said the other day...
lines.zh: : 就是……前几天你说的话……

lines.en: : I...I realize I...
lines.zh: : 我……我意识到我……

lines.en: scene osakosarabar28
: Uhh...I realized my...reaction...wasn’t really...uhh...
lines.zh: : 呃……我意识到我的……反应……其实不太……呃……

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. I was just being dumb.
lines.zh: : 别放在心上。我只是在犯蠢。

lines.en: scene osakosarabar29
: Just...being...dumb?...
: Yeah. It’s nothing you need to be worried about.
lines.zh: : 对。不是你需要担心的事。

lines.en: : Can you grab us two more beers, though? I’m going to need them.
lines.zh: : 不过,能给我们再来两瓶啤酒吗?我会需要的。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: scene osakosarabar30
: To...drink?
lines.zh: : 为了……喝?

lines.en: : ...Sana?
lines.zh: : ……Sana?

lines.en: scene osakosarabar31
: It’s nothing.
lines.zh: : 没什么。

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll be right back with your order...
lines.zh: : 我马上去拿你们点的东西……

lines.en: scene nightsky
Osako and I talk for another hour or so before we decide to head out.
lines.zh: Osako 和我又聊了大约一个钟头,才决定起身离开。

lines.en: Things get less serious, thankfully. Though, I probably shouldn’t be too thankful when it was me who made things serious in the first place.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地,话题变得不那么严肃了。不过,既然一开始是我把话题搞严肃的,我大概也不该谢得太用力。

lines.en: Am I glad that I essentially admitted to her what I’ve been doing? Nope. In fact, I feel ten times worse.
lines.zh: 我为自己把一直在做的事实质上向她坦白而高兴吗?不。事实上,我感觉糟糕了十倍。

lines.en: But...
lines.zh: 但是……

lines.en: I think I get what she was saying about failure feeling good now, though.
lines.zh: 不过,关于失败的感觉居然不坏,我想我现在懂她说的了。

lines.en: And I think the fact that I feel this shameful at all is indicative of something bigger.
lines.zh: 而且我觉得,我居然还能感到如此羞耻,这个事实本身就暗示着某种更大的东西。

lines.en: I really like being with her.
lines.zh: 我真的很喜欢和她在一起。

lines.en: scene osakosarabar32
But all good things must come to an end. And for tomorrow to ever begin, we must first bid farewell to today.
lines.zh: 但一切美好的事物终有尽时。而要让明天开始,我们必须先与今天道别。

lines.en: Perhaps what comes when the sun shines again won’t make me feel like I’ve lived in the dark all these years.
lines.zh: 也许,当太阳再次照耀时迎来的东西,不会让我觉得这些年我活在黑暗里。

lines.en: I just know that, whatever happens next, I must feel like a failure to ever know what it means to succeed.
lines.zh: 我只知道,无论接下来发生什么,我必须先感觉自己是失败者,才能懂得成功的含义。

lines.en: I hope she finds her happiness first — for she is far more deserving than a cretin like me.
lines.zh: 我希望她先找到她的幸福——因为她远比一个像我这样的低能儿更配得上。

lines.en: : Are you gonna be okay?
lines.zh: : 你没事吧?

lines.en: : Yeah...I just need to get my head straight.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我只是需要把脑子理顺。

lines.en: : No. I mean are you going to be okay walking home? You don’t need me to be your bodyguard?
lines.zh: : 不。我是问你一个人走回家行吗?不需要我当你的保镖?

lines.en: : Oh. Come to think of it, I would feel a little more comfortable if you were to just stay in my room with me tonight. Fight off any demons that come to claim me. You might have to sign an NDA, though.
lines.zh: : 哦。这么一想,你今晚要是干脆留在我房间里,我确实会更安心一点。赶走任何来收走我的恶魔。不过,你可能得签一份保密协议。

lines.en: : Meh. I think I’ll just let you be claimed by the demons. It was nice knowing you, though.
lines.zh: : 唔。我想我还是让你被恶魔收走吧。不过,认识你很高兴。

lines.en: : Yeah. Nice knowing you too, Osako.
lines.zh: : 是啊。认识你我也很高兴,Osako。

lines.en: : Guess I’ll just...see you when I see you then.
lines.zh: : 那,我猜就……该见面时再见面了。

lines.en: : I’ll send you the class list. I’m serious about letting you choose the next one.
lines.zh: : 我会把课程清单发给你。让你挑下一门课,我是认真的。

lines.en: : Osako-
lines.zh: : Osako——

lines.en: : This doesn’t have to just be for me anymore. We can figure shit out together.
lines.zh: : 从今往后,这就不必只是为我一个人了。我们可以一起把这些烂摊子理出头绪。

lines.en: : And if you ever need to talk, you know where I live.
lines.zh: : 还有,如果你需要找人谈,你知道我住哪儿。

lines.en: : Wakana is going to be so jealous of how close we’re getting.
lines.zh: : 看到我们变得这么亲近,Wakana 会嫉妒死的。

lines.en: scene osakosarabar33
: Maybe she’ll finally know how I felt then!
lines.zh: : 说不定她终于能体会我当时的感受了!

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: scene black
: Night, Akira! Don’t do anything stupid! Like...seriously! You do some really stupid shit!
lines.zh: : 晚安,Akira!别干蠢事!我是说……认真的!你干的蠢事可真不少!

lines.en: : Goodnight, Osako. Have fun banging my future girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 晚安,Osako。祝你上我未来女朋友愉快。

lines.en: I don’t get a snarky response this time.
lines.zh: 这一次,我没有等到一句尖酸的回应。

lines.en: scene osakosarabar34
Just more indecision and the unwelcome recollection of another strange night when I turn around to head home.
lines.zh: 当我转身踏上归途,得到的只是更多的犹豫不决,和另一场怪异夜晚不合时宜的回忆。

lines.en: : Nao-chan! Grabbing more than three wiggleworms at once will confuse the Frog Boy! You must move slowly! Only one at a time!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱!一次抓取三只以上的蠕蠕虫,会让青蛙少年陷入混乱!你必须缓慢行动!一次只能一只!

lines.en: I took her first time and have barely looked at her since.
lines.zh: 我夺走了她的第一次,此后却几乎没再看过她一眼。

lines.en: But was it really her at all?
lines.zh: 可那真的是她吗?

lines.en: : Ah! The hot bean water! I forgot to empty its mesh-bed! Wait right there, Nao-chan! I will return in seventeen seconds!
lines.zh: : 啊!热豆之水!我忘记清空它的滤网之床了!原地稍候,Nao 酱!我将在十七秒内归来!

lines.en: Why hasn’t she come to see me?
lines.zh: 为什么她没来见我?

lines.en: Is she scared?
lines.zh: 她害怕吗?

lines.en: She doesn’t sound scared.
lines.zh: 她听起来不像害怕。

lines.en: She doesn’t sound any different at all.
lines.zh: 她的声音听起来没有任何不同。

lines.en: scene black
She probably doesn’t even realize what happened.
lines.zh: 她大概根本没意识到发生了什么。

lines.en: : Nao-chan, is something not right? What has drawn your attention so late in the night?
lines.zh: : Nao 酱,可是出了什么不对?如此深夜,是什么引走了你的注意?

lines.en: I’m gone before I hear Kaori say anything else.
lines.zh: 在我听见 Kaori 再说任何话之前,我已经离开了。

lines.en: One more word and I would have kicked down the door.
lines.zh: 再多一个字,我就会踹开那扇门。

$ osako_love += 1
Osako’s affection has increased to [osako_love]!
lines.zh: Osako 的好感度提升到了 [osako_love]!
